from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0062.png"))

mask_pot = (img[:, :, 0] > 120) & (img[:, :, 0] < 200) & (img[:, :, 1] > 50) & (img[:, :, 1] < 100) & (img[:, :, 2] < 60)

    print(f"Plant: xs=[{xg.min()}, {xg.max()}], ys=[{yg.min()}, {yg.max()}], bottom={yg.max()}, cx={xg.mean():.1f}")
